findings.message: `proj.analytics.Orders` is partitioned by `order_date`, but `order_date = '2026-09-30' OR amount > 0` can't limit which partitions are read. BigQuery rejects queries on this table unless a filter on `order_date` can limit the partitions.
findings.fix: Add a filter on `order_date`, for example `order_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 7 DAY)`.
